szoveg_eredeti:
Hi Product Hunt, I'm Troy, and I built Kin.

Every AI app I used wanted its own connection to my accounts, and each asked permission its own way. Kin puts one gate in the middle: connect an account once, pick Allow, Ask me or Block for each action, and approve from your iPhone or Apple Watch. One log shows every move, and one button pauses every AI app.

It works with ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and Grok. Free to start, and Pro is free for 7 days with no card.

I'd love to hear what you'd want gated first.

Weboldal: https://kinlab.ai/?utm_source=producthunt\u0026utm_medium=social\u0026utm_campaign=launch-2026-10\u0026utm_content=listing
